$comment: Each key is a whole ConsentDialogData — pass one as the dialog's data.

preConsultation.title: Before your video consultation
preConsultation.intro: Please review and agree to the following. You can withdraw optional consents at any time from your profile.

clauses.title: Telehealth terms of service
clauses.body: A remote consultation cannot include a physical examination. Your clinician may ask you to attend in person if a diagnosis needs one.

clauses.title: Processing of your health information
clauses.body: Your clinician records notes from this consultation in your medical record. Records are retained for the period required by law.

clauses.title: Recording this consultation
clauses.body: The call may be recorded for quality assurance. Declining does not affect your care, and the consultation proceeds without a recording.

clauses.title: Use of de-identified data for research
clauses.body: De-identified information may be used to improve clinical services. Nothing that identifies you is shared.

allRequired.$comment: Every clause mandatory — the optional section is not rendered at all.
allRequired.title: Consent to treatment

clauses.title: Consent to treatment
clauses.body: I consent to receive care from the assigned clinician.

clauses.title: Sharing with your GP
clauses.body: A summary is sent to your registered general practitioner.

singleOptional.$comment: Nothing is required — Agree is enabled from the start, but nothing is pre-ticked.
singleOptional.title: Optional: research participation

clauses.title: Use of de-identified data for research
clauses.body: You can change this at any time and it never affects the care you receive.
